summary: Slice 0 (Foundation) verified end-to-end. Backend audit-log endpoints + KNOWN_ACTIONS catalogue + services/audit.log_admin_action round-trip all pass. All 10 new placeholder routes + 10 existing admin routes + 4 public routes return 200. Playwright login → sidebar shows 5 grouped sections (Mission Control / Community / Website / Insights / System) with 8 'Soon' pills; /admin/audit-log renders filter controls + 'Ask George about this log' button + empty-state card; /admin/members ComingSoon renders with 'Slice 1' pill, title, parity list, and improvements list. 29/29 pytest cases green (see /app/test_reports/pytest/iter118_slice0.xml). No blocking issues found.

issues: Wording nit only — the brief said 'filter chips' but the UI uses a native <select> ('All actions' dropdown) + a free-text Target type input. Functionally equivalent, but if chips are preferred UX, a follow-up styling pass would swap the select for pill buttons.

action_items: (Optional / non-blocking) Consider swapping the audit-log Action <select> for filter-chip buttons to match the brief's wording — purely cosmetic.
Future slices should ensure every consequential admin write calls services.audit.log_admin_action so the log actually populates.
critical_code_review_comments: services/audit.py is clean, append-only, safely swallows Mongo errors so audit failures never break the caller — good defensive design.
cms_module.py imports the audit module lazily inside build_router() (line 1671). Works, but a top-level import would be slightly cleaner; keeping as-is is fine.
Round-trip test uses a scoped TEST_slice0_admin admin_id and deletes the row in a finally block, so the log stays empty in prod DB.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (sidebar groups, Soon pills, filter row, Ask George button, Members ComingSoon all render as designed)

seed_data_creation: None. The round-trip test inserts one admin_log row (admin_id='TEST_slice0_admin') via services.audit.log_admin_action and deletes it in a finally block; log left empty.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_slice0_audit.py covers audit auth guard, admin-log shape, KNOWN_ACTIONS catalogue (>=20 entries, spot-checks member.warn/content.remove/group.approve), helper→API round-trip, all 10 new placeholder routes, 10 existing admin routes, and 4 public routes. Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_slice0_audit.py -v. Login flow: CMS admin login must be driven via type() (not fill), then wait_for_function(!/admin/login), then click sidebar <a href> links for client-side nav — direct page.goto to protected routes can race the AdminShell's /api/cms/auth/me guard.
